procedure.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d) && for m in maind analyst harness; do HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm packages/$m/bin/$m doctor --json > $H/$m.json; rc=$?; [ $rc -le 1 ] || exit $rc; done && PYTHONPATH=packages/aicore/lib python3 -c 'import json, sys; from pathlib import Path; from aicore.util import schema; reg, kind = schema.load_contract(Path("packages/aicore/schemas/check-result/v1")); docs = [(f, d) for f in sys.argv[1:] for d in json.load(open(f))]; assert all(json.load(open(f)) for f in sys.argv[1:]), "empty doctor output"; bad = [(f, d.get("check_id"), schema.validate(d, kind, reg)) for f, d in docs if schema.validate(d, kind, reg)]; assert not bad, bad' $H/maind.json $H/analyst.json $H/harness.json
